corpus_stability.reason: The California Driver's Handbook is a stable annual issuer publication, so Section Three testing facts change at most once per year.

ranked.label: Attempt clocks: three tries, seven-day knowledge retakes, fourteen-day drive retakes for minors
Vehicle numbers: tread depth, pedal clearance, horn distance, two mirrors, both brake lights
Test-day tech: assistance systems out, cameras allowed but eyes still rule, recorders banned
Knowledge tests are multiple choice and aid-free
Bring license papers, a licensed adult, a legal car, and a clean rental contract

sections.heading: C - California Driver's Handbook Section Three: The Testing Process
sections.markdown:
## C - California Driver's Handbook Section Three: The Testing Process

FACT_ID: sec03-F01 | anchor: A01
DMV vision-tests every applicant to confirm sight adequate for safe driving [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F02 | anchor: A01
Testing while wearing corrective or contact lenses puts a corrective lenses restriction on the license [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F03 | anchor: A01
A failed vision test sends you to an eye doctor for a completed Report of Vision Examination (DL 62) form [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F04 | anchor: A01
Vision standards detail lives at dmv.ca.gov/vision-standards [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F05 | anchor: A01
An original license requires passing a knowledge test built from multiple choice questions [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F06 | anchor: A01
You get three attempts to pass before you must reapply [A01].
Why it matters: the three-attempt cap is the quantities anchor of this section.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F07 | anchor: A01
Minors wait seven days, excluding the failure day, before retaking a failed knowledge test [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F08 | anchor: A01
Renewals may substitute eLearning, a no-fail self-paced interactive modulated course with quizzes after each module, taken on computer, laptop, tablet, or mobile device [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F09 | anchor: A01
Testing options open up once the application at dmv.ca.gov/dl is complete [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F10 | anchor: A01
No testing aids are allowed during knowledge tests, neither the handbook nor a cell phone [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F11 | anchor: A01
Original applicants take a behind-the-wheel test of safe driving ability, and renewing drivers with a vision or medical condition may have to take one too [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F12 | anchor: A01
The examiner may stack two or more instructions at once to see whether you grasp and follow both [A01].
Why it matters: stacked directions test listening, for example two left turns in a row.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F13 | anchor: A01
Drive-test appointments are booked at dmv.ca.gov/make-an-appointment [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-F14 | anchor: A02
On test day bring the instruction permit or license if one exists [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F15 | anchor: A02
Also bring another California-licensed driver aged at least eighteen, twenty-five for minors, unless already licensed to drive [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F16 | anchor: A02
Bring a vehicle safe for the test plus valid insurance proof and vehicle registration [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F17 | anchor: A02
Rental cars qualify only with your name on the rental contract and no contract clause excluding drive tests [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F18 | anchor: A02
Minors wait fourteen days, excluding the failure day, before retaking a failed behind-the-wheel test [A02].
Why it matters: the drive-test wait is the longer of the two minor retake clocks.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F19 | anchor: A02
The pre-drive check starts with an opening driver window and a windshield giving you and the examiner a full, clear, unblocked view, since cracks can postpone the test [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F20 | anchor: A02
At least two rearview mirrors are required, with one on the vehicle's left side [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F21 | anchor: A02
Both right and left brake lights must work [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F22 | anchor: A02
Tires need at least 1/32-inch of uniformed tread depth, and donut tires are barred from the test [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F23 | anchor: A02
The depressed foot brake must keep at least one inch of clearance above the floorboard [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F24 | anchor: A02
The horn must be vehicle-designed, working, and audible from at least 200 feet away [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F25 | anchor: A02
You must show how to set and release the parking brake [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F26 | anchor: A02
You must demonstrate the left turn, right turn, and slowing-or-stopping arm signals [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F27 | anchor: A02
Wipers may be function-checked, and every seat belt must work and be worn by each occupant [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F28 | anchor: A02
A vehicle that fails these requirements gets the drive test rescheduled [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-F29 | anchor: A03
Interpreters may help identify and use controls in the pre-drive inspection but cannot ride along for the test [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-F30 | anchor: A03
Only the examiner accompanies the drive test, except for training, service animals, and certain law enforcement situations [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-F31 | anchor: A03
Recording devices, including video recorders, are prohibited on the drive test, and one that cannot power off must be blocked from all visual and audio recording [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-F32 | anchor: A03
Because the test grades the driver rather than the car, assistance tech such as automated parallel parking, lane departure, and adaptive cruise control is banned [A03].
Why it matters: the skill-not-technology principle explains every test-day equipment rule.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-F33 | anchor: A03
Safety tech such as backup cameras and blind spot monitors is allowed yet never replaces direct mirror and blind-spot checks [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-F34 | anchor: A03
Sample Driving Performance Evaluation Score Sheets live at dmv.ca.gov/teendriver, with Supplemental and Area sheets at dmv.ca.gov/seniors [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]
